Product Disclaimer: Product packaging may vary.
Somebody on the Secret Lair team, and I’m not naming names, really thrived in high school. We’re talking all-state homecoming royalty with valedictorian energy—a real yearbook superstar. And, well, they kinda . . . miss it and bring it up all the time. So this drop of legends, reimagined in their high-school glory days by Stephen Andrade & Scott Okumura, is a little bit of wish fulfillment. But then again, so is every drop. Have a Great Summer!
Contents:
• 1x Reversible Aesi, Tyrant of Gyre Strait
• 1x Reversible Anje Falkenrath
• 1x Reversible Chulane, Teller of Tales
• 1x Reversible Radha, Heart of Keld

When purchasing this unique product, please keep in mind that this Secret Lair Drop Series Sealed Product will ship out to you after the seller receives the product directly from Wizards of the Coast.

The estimated time frame for sellers to receive stock is not fixed, so it could be anywhere between 1 - 10 weeks for delivery.
